description: Machine-readable registry of Relying Parties whose published discovery document passes the identity-only Agent Identity Protocol conformance validator. The human-readable view is registry/README.md; the two are kept in lockstep.
capability_vocabulary_note: Protocol capabilities only. Vendor features such as provisioning, catalogs, SKUs, pricing, OTP endpoints, and resource APIs are vendor responsibilities documented in the vendor's post-signup guide, not protocol capabilities, and must never appear here.
verification_note: OPTIONAL per-entry `verification` object (broker, level, attestation_jti, checked_at, status), validated by registry/implementations.schema.json. Conformance and verification are separate, and the object is a snapshot at checked_at. Reference Provider carries a domain-level snapshot from the live 2026-11-24 check; the registry is not a live feed and verification is not a safety or endorsement claim.
